name: Profile lookup crashes on unknown user
modeled_on: A lookup helper returns None for missing records and the caller subscripts the result unconditionally. This is the NULL-dereference bug class that repeatedly shows up in auth/session code across open-source projects when a 'get or create' helper is replaced by a plain 'get'. Modeled on the same shape as the bundled auth demo, expanded to a standalone profile module.
ground_truth: Guard the lookup result: return None when the user is missing instead of subscripting it.
